about: Default Claude Code (2025-11-25 handshake) with every skill disabled, so only the server's instructions, descriptions and guide steer the agent. Four labels that can all be true, plus urgency.
command: A customer wrote: "Third time this week the export button does nothing. I'm on the Pro plan paying $40/mo and I want a refund if this isn't fixed today." Which of these apply: bug report, billing question, refund request, churn risk? And how urgent is it? I want calibrated probabilities, not your impression.
